notes.title: Our Alpha is now ready and available for testing
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are making Miniverse Wars available to selected users for testing and hope this will allow us to collect valuable feedback and continue improving our game.

To start this feedback process, we will speak with the participants on Discord and ask a few questions to guide the conversation and collect the answers. 

We would really love to grow our list of participants so if you are interested please join us on Discord with this link: https://discord.gg/a6mD6JQ. We will provide you with a free Steam key and in return we would really apppreciate it if you could provide your feedback. 

Our small team has put a lot of effort into making this first version available and we truly hope you will enjoy it and help us move it forward.

Thank you,

Bellosoft Team

notes.title: New special effects implemented this week :)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

This week we have continued the implementation of new special effects to give you cool visual feedback about what's happening while you play.

If one of your planets has been conquered by a pirate ship, this will sign you need to keep alert:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987989/310f637148c6c54f6089f7e1b3063977a6fb5773.gif[/img]

When your asteroid and nebula resources have been depleted, they will look like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987989/06fb58de045402510a80f2d969014e3062fbae7f.gif[/img]  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987989/5585d245db4c2b85c147a9199d0b8b6269f0474f.gif[/img]

And the coloniser ray will indicate you are successfully colonising a new planet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987989/56096893dab02da3d98a1f4a657dd06ad246602b.gif[/img]

Apart from the effects above, we have also added images to our How to Play panel and think it looks much nicer now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987989/3ddda052a949758cc89438abdb8b0ca4e449ccef.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987989/24d7c4026aca68ce686c8673ed798f6d8104b8ea.png[/img]

Let us know what you think!

Thanks for reading.

notes.title: Check out our progress for this week.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Just writing to show you a bit of the progress we have made this week on Miniverse Wars.

- Our new planet menu has been fully implemented and we hope it will make user experience much easier now. It will allow you to take all the actions related to your planets and show all the information you need about them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987989/f7c665a802dee0c36223d139aefdd5e2c561365e.png[/img]

- Our ships now look different according to their level of upgrade. The ships on the left-hand side are the ones with level 1 upgrade. See the evolution of the levels. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35987989/29de94c97d7bc0e321d0e080921408a92ded9294.png[/img]

- We have also started the implementation of the planets' life bar and hope to complete it soon. 

And... we will have a new video soon to share with you :)

Thanks for reading!
